comment: Exo Shield's network rules. Each group blocks requests made by the provider pages in "from" (and only by them). "domains" blocks every request to those hosts and their subdomains; "urls" blocks requests whose address contains the pattern (declarativeNetRequest urlFilter syntax: || anchors at a host, ^ is a separator). Every entry was seen on the provider's own page; README.md says how to find and update one.
